neighbours.label: a contrastive discourse marker ('however', 'on the other hand', German 'dagegen/hingegen') set off mid-sentence; the - pole is the additive side ('also', 'additionally')
fire: Most critics loved the film. The audience, however, left the cinema confused.
Freud stressed early childhood. Adler, on the other hand, focused on social feelings.
The plan saves money. It does, however, create new problems for small towns.
In Britain the trains run late. In Japan, however, delays are almost unknown.
Früher blieben die Kinder zu Hause. Heute dagegen gehen sie früh in die Kita.
The old phone was heavy. The new model, by contrast, weighs almost nothing.
Cats sleep most of the day. Dogs, on the other hand, need long walks.
Der erste Versuch scheiterte. Der zweite hingegen war ein voller Erfolg.
